The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 37e6d650c989c3fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume Theorem 3.1. Let X be a smooth projective complex variety with pseudo-effective canonical divisor. A KX-MMP with scaling of an effective ample rational divisor H, chosen so that (X, H) is klt and KX + H is ample, terminates with nef canonical divisor. Consequently, on a smooth projective birational model p : U → X one has p∗ KX = P + N, P nef and rational Cartier, N ≥ 0 rational Cartier.
